description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Figure_Polygon, which is a part of a PHP library for rendering graphs and images. It includes methods for adding vertices and rendering a polygon shape on a canvas, extending the Image_Graph_Element class. The file also includes licensing, package, and author metadata.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Figure_Polygon
classes.description: Class for creating and rendering a polygon shape on a canvas as part of the Image_Graph library.

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to the polygon with specified x and y coordinates.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the polygon shape on the canvas, including setting styles and grouping.
